summary: Lee Enterprises filed an 8-K reporting a First Amendment to a Stock Purchase Agreement with a group of investors. The amendment modifies standstill provisions, allowing investors who beneficially own more than 10% to continue purchasing up to 600,000 shares in open market transactions during the standstill period, and permits purchases exceeding that limit if executed via a qualified Rule 10b5-1 trading plan approved by the company. No price per share, premium, or change of control terms are stated. This is a routine contractual adjustment, not a special situation event.
